brief: A lidded box for the glovebox: a screwdriver stored inside a cell with a cover closing the top over it.

events.text: Building your lidded glovebox box — screwdriver tucked under a closing lid.

connector.note: A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. Bases that touch with no connector on the wall between them are one body (joint bolts); every wall between two groups needs a connector, walls inside a group stay bare. get_build lists each touching wall and the groups. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

jointBolt.note: A joint bolt fastens the wall between two touching bases. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
